title: Enabling lab autonomy with reward functions and executable workflows
title_zh: 利用奖励函数和可执行工作流实现实验室自主性
abstract: Kalinin et al. argue that for self-driving laboratories to achieve autonomy in the physical world, large language model hypothesis generation needs to be complemented by bottom-up optimization translating hypotheses into executable workflows.
abstract_zh: Kalinin 等人认为，自主实验室要想在物理世界中实现自主运行，大语言模型的假设生成需要辅以自下而上的优化，将假设转化为可执行的工作流。
snippet: Kalinin et al. argue that for self-driving laboratories to achieve autonomy in the physical world, large language model hypothesis generation needs to be complemented by bottom-up optimization translating hypotheses into executable workflows.
authors_text: Sergei V. Kalinin, Boris N. Slautin, Yu Liu, Elham Foadian, Gerd Duscher, Mahshid Ahmadi, Timur Bazhirov
